validation_log.check: Milestone 1.6 full regression, rendered review and native Windows throughput
validation_log.evidence: GODOT_BIN=$(command -v godot) tests/run_ui_regression.sh: UI_REGRESSION_OK suites=25 matrices=4 persistence_restart=passed, including all Phase 0 suites, five ENet rematches, four-client match, authority and 4/8/20-player rankings/spectator/lobby-return matrices. Runner requires positive markers and rejects parser/runtime/assertion/font-RID errors; reports known shutdown-only audio resource diagnostics separately. New orphan-count regression first failed: results_table/lobby_roster allocated unattached children in member initializers and freeing an unmounted scene leaked ten CanvasItems/font resources. Allocation moved into _ready; PHASE1_TESTS_OK=32 exits cleanly. A deferred-test experiment did not fix the cause and was removed. All eight render suites pass at 720p/1080p: milestone1_1=85, HUD=201, roster=127, lobby=39, spectator=79 before added visible-capture assertions, table=487, actions=35, settings=38. Inspected default HUD, Meteor warning, Tornado/Flood/drowning overlap, 20-row scrolled lobby, host-ready, spectator notice/fallback, results with Settings and 1080p dark HUD/drowning/spectator/client results/settings: legible hierarchy, contained controls and no unwanted HUD. Initial fallback failures measured hidden stale-result geometry; reset presentation state and added actual visibility assertion. Checksum-verified native Windows Godot 4.7.2 through WSL UNC checkout, Compatibility, Ryzen AI 7 H 350 / AMD Radeon 860M driver 25.20.24.03.251024, 1280x720, four demo players, staged Flood/Tornado, 120 warmup/600 samples: two explicitly V-Sync-disabled runs p50 0.67/0.68 ms, p95 1.08/1.08 ms, 128 draw calls, 532 nodes, target_60fps_met=true, ui_nodes_stable=true. Profile now exits nonzero for failed budget or rebuilt UI. Default-V-Sync runs p95 24.09/24.65 ms remain a separate frame-pacing limitation, not claimed fixed gameplay; removing the limiter without explicit V-Sync disable did not establish uncapped throughput. Synthetic joypad/Dummy audio still do not verify physical hardware or multi-PC playtesting.
